sql: /* Query 2: agg1_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT manager.nationality, MIN(city.population) AS min_city_population FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name GROUP BY manager.nationality

nationality.description: nationality is the nationality of the team owner (e.g. American).

population.description: population is the population of the city (e.g. 7000000).
